stem: The graph of the probability density function f of a random variable $X$ is symmetrical about the line $x = 2$. It is given that $\text{P}(2 < X < 5) = \frac{117}{256}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Using only this information show that $\text{P}(X > -1) = \frac{245}{256}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
It is now given that, for $x$ in a suitable domain,

$$\text{f}(x) = k(12 + 4x - x^2), \ \text{where}\ k\ \text{is a constant.}$$

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A different random variable $X$ has probability density function $\text{g}(x) = \frac{2}{9}\left(2 + x - x^2\right)$. The domain of $X$ is all values of $x$ for which $\text{g}(x) \geqslant 0$.

Find $\text{Var}(X)$.
